news.title: Nepal’s Deadliest Glacier Collapse Exposes Larger Risks
news.description: The disaster killed more than 1,500 people and took a tenth of Nepal's power capacity off the grid. Unlike the glacial lake outburst floods Nepal monitors, an ice-rock avalanche gives forecasters little warning.

news.title: Maine judge rules school board committee discriminated against church over lease argument
news.description: A federal judge ruled Friday that Maine school officials discriminated against The Pines Church of Bangor with bad motivations over religious-based questions.
